chartBlockPropsSchema.source:
z
  .object({
    id: z.string().optional(),
    title: z.string().max(120).optional(),
    kind: z.enum(CHART_KINDS),
    categories: z.array(z.string()).min(1).max(24),
    series: z.array(chartSeriesSchema).min(1).max(8).optional(),
    unit: z.string().max(16).optional(),
  })
  .refine(
    (data) =>
      (data.series ?? []).every((item) => item.values.length === data.categories.length),
    { message: 'series.values.length must equal categories.length', path: ['series'] },
  )

rules.numbers: i64→Long; u64→ULong/decimal lexeme; arbitrary JSON numbers retain original token; no Double projection
rules.null: nullable option emits null; skipIf none omits; empty string is distinct
rules.unknown: unknown JSON members and content nodes survive semantic round-trip
rules.text: UTF-8 exact bytes; no NFC/NFD normalization; retain CRLF outside edited span
rules.hash: SHA-256 over declared UTF-8/binary bytes; lowercase hex; no added BOM/newline
rules.objectOrder: typed struct declaration order; map order follows captured schema; ordinary JSON compared semantically; hashed payload compared byte-for-byte
